_comment: 2027 traded-pick overlay, applied on top of the standings-derived draft order (see src/lib/pickTrades.ts). Verified against Wikipedia's '2027 NHL entry draft' article (which cites NHL.com/TSN/team press releases) on 2026-09-29/30. protectedTopN/splitRecipient conditions are checked against each team's FINAL post-lottery pick slot.

round1.source: Wikipedia: 2027 NHL entry draft, Round one #1 - condition converted April 16, 2026 (Daily Faceoff, "Panthers to keep 2026 first-round pick; will transfer 2027 pick to Blackhawks")

Wikipedia: 2027 NHL entry draft, Unresolved conditional picks - Dickinson/Dach-for-Mangiapane trade (NHL.com, March 4, 2026). Note: real condition also triggers if Edmonton trades its 2028 1st before the 2027 deadline - not standings-derivable, not modeled.

Toronto's own pick never stays with Toronto; simplified here to always go to Philadelphia rather than modeling the top-10 choice between Boston/Philadelphia.
